name: v3.33.0
body:
Release notes can be found [on GitHub](https://github.com/projectcalico/calico/blob/release-v3.33/release-notes/v3.33.0-release-notes.md)

Attached to this release are the following artifacts:

- `release-v3.33.0.tgz`: container images, binaries, and kubernetes manifests.
- `calico-windows-v3.33.0.zip`: Calico for Windows.
- `tigera-operator-v3.33.0.tgz`: Calico Helm 3 chart (also hosted at oci://quay.io/calico/charts/tigera-operator).
- `crd.projectcalico.org.v1-v3.33.0.tgz`: Calico crd.projectcalico.org/v1 CRD chart.
- `projectcalico.org.v3-v3.33.0.tgz`: Calico projectcalico.org/v3 CRD chart (tech-preview).
- ocp.tgz: Manifest bundle for OpenShift.

Additional links:

- [VPP data plane release information](https://github.com/projectcalico/vpp-dataplane/blob/master/RELEASE_NOTES.md)
